Against: No swelling, erythema, warmth, or effusion — hallmark signs of crystal arthritis; no history of prior attacks, hyperuricemia, or metabolic comorbidities reported

Septic arthritis

Rheumatoid arthritis or other autoimmune inflammatory arthropathy  
Supporting: CRP/ESR ordered to evaluate for autoimmune arthropathy

Verdict: KEEP — labs pending, and seronegative or early presentations can mimic mechanical pain; no finding *contradicts*, though highly atypical

Supporting: Knee pain in active individual
